meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Use Orca orchestration for structured multi-agent coordination: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply flows, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, or decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` instead for full ownership handoffs, including requests phrased as "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", or "another worktree" when the user did not explicitly ask to supervise, monitor, wait for results, or coordinate a DAG. Use `orca-cli` for ordinary terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, reading or waiting on terminals, and automation of the browser embedded inside Orca. Use Computer Use for browser windows, webviews, Orca app UI, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser.

copy.tagline: 协调多个智能体分工协作完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把一个大任务拆成多个助手并行处理并汇总结果。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate multiple AI agents to split and execute complex tasks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple AI assistants and need structured task coordination.

howto.what: 当需要多个智能体协作时，Claude 会先确定 Orca 命令行工具，读取当前版本的官方指南，再据此创建任务、分派给不同智能体、等待完成并汇总。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化协调多个智能体，如分派任务、等待某个智能体完成、或设置任务间的先后依赖时。

say.text: 帮我派两个智能体，一个写代码，一个做测试，等两个都完成再汇总。
say.note: Claude 会通过 Orca 创建并跟踪这两个任务。

say.text: 派一个智能体去查资料，等它出结果后再继续下一步。
say.note: 会等待该智能体完成后再继续。

say.text: 把这三个小任务依次发给不同智能体，最后统一汇总。
say.note: 按顺序派发并等待结果。

howto.what_en: When multi-agent coordination is needed, Claude resolves the correct Orca executable, fetches the version-matched guide via `orca skills get orchestration`, then uses it to create and dispatch tasks, wait for workers, and coordinate DAGs or decision gates.
howto.when_en: When you need structured multi-agent coordination: dispatching tasks, waiting for worker completion, or defining task dependencies (DAGs).

say_en.text: Assign two agents, one to code and one to test, then summarize when both finish.
say_en.note: Claude tracks both tasks via Orca.

say_en.text: Send an agent to research, and continue only after it returns results.
say_en.note: Waits for that agent to finish.

say_en.text: Dispatch these three subtasks to different agents in order and gather results.
